title: Uploaded artifact is missing dotfiles and folders such as .next or .output
symptoms: Artifact zip lacks files whose names start with a dot
Downstream deploy job fails because the build folder is empty
Warning that no files were found for a path pointing at a dot folder
cause: Since September 2, 2024 (upload-artifact v4.4.0), hidden files and anything inside dot folders are excluded by default to avoid leaking credentials.
fix: Set include-hidden-files: true and exclude sensitive files explicitly in path.
apply:
- uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
  with:
    name: build
    include-hidden-files: true
    path: |
      .next/
      !.next/cache/
